name: Role & Responsibility Assignment
description: Ensures clear assignment of roles and responsibilities for agent oversight, including who owns the agent, who reviews its behavior, and who is accountable for its actions. Maps human accountability to autonomous agent operations.
threat_addressed: Without clear ownership and accountability assignments, agent incidents have no responsible party, remediation is delayed, and regulatory accountability requirements cannot be met. Orphaned agents with no designated owner pose escalating risk.
enforcement_mechanism: Validates that agent configuration declares an owner, and that oversight roles are defined. Tracks accountability chain from agent action to responsible human operator.

security_outcome.pass: Agent owner and oversight roles clearly assigned and documented.
security_outcome.fail: Agent ownership or oversight responsibilities undefined.

display_detail: Validates that agent ownership, oversight roles, and accountability assignments are documented.
remediation_hint_template: Agent owner not assigned. Add agent.owner in ancilis.yaml to establish accountability for this agent's actions.
